question: "Abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals, institutions, the National Flag and the National Anthem" is a ________ mentioned in the Indian Constitution.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental Duties**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Fundamental Duties

 
 
• In the Constitution of India, fundamental duties are mentioned in Article 51A.
 
• There was no list of fundamental duties in the original constitution.
 
• Fundamental duties were added to the Indian constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act 1976 on the recommendation of the Sardar Swarn Singh committee.
